title: 1964 nickel found in drill site
summary: Breaks Silence tells of 1964 nickel found in drill site, about 1964 at Skinwalker Ranch mesa, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: recently brought out a 1964 aged nickel

plain: On a podcast episode about Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, a speaker who says he was there describes how drilling on the ranch's mesa recently brought up a nickel dated 1964. He mentions a man named Chris Roberts. A coin turning up deep in a drill site is told as a puzzle about what lies under the ranch.
